info.title: routebase
info.description: Command-line client for Routebase: run API test suites and security scans in CI, promote spec versions after a deploy, and sync documentation as Markdown. Requires a Routebase account and an API key.

x-inspectra.cliParsedDescription: Routebase CLI - run test suites and security scans, promote spec versions, sync docs as Markdown

commands.name: docs
commands.description: Docs-as-Code: sync documentation between Routebase and local Markdown files

commands.name: pull
commands.description: Download a documentation version into a local Markdown folder structure

options.name: --project
options.description: The project ID

options.name: --doc
options.description: The documentation ID (optional if the project has exactly one)

options.name: --version-id
options.description: The version ID to pull (default: highest version number)

options.name: --dir
options.description: Output directory for the Markdown files

commands.name: push
commands.description: Upload a local Markdown folder structure into a mutable documentation version

options.name: --project
options.description: The project ID

options.name: --doc
options.description: The documentation ID (optional if the project has exactly one)

options.name: --version-id
options.description: The version ID to push into (default: newest mutable Draft/Review version)

options.name: --dir
options.description: Local directory containing the Markdown files

options.name: --dry-run
options.description: Show what would change without writing anything

commands.name: promote
commands.description: Promote a spec version into an environment

options.name: --env
options.description: Target environment — name or id

options.name: --project
options.description: Project id. Defaults to 'routebase config set-project'.

arguments.name: SPEC
arguments.description: The API specification — name or id

arguments.name: VERSION
arguments.description: The version to promote — number (e.g. 1.0.0) or id
